title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rules of varying complexity. RuleMaze isolates rule-compliant spatial planning by requiring accurate perception, rule interpretation, and constrained action planning. To enable scalable and systematic rule construction, we propose Language-Logic-Function Hybridization, which automatically generates natural-language rules and translates them into logical representations and executable validators, eliminating manual rule engineering. translated_title: 面向多模态大语言模型的合规视觉空间规划
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）将语言推理与视觉感知相结合，但它们在显式或先前未见过的规则约束下执行视觉空间规划的能力仍未得到充分探索。这一设置要求模型联合理解空间布局、解释自然语言规则，并据此规划有效动作。为解决这一空白，我们引入了RuleMaze，一个可控基准测试，其中MLLMs必须遵守不同复杂度的自然语言规则来导航迷宫。RuleMaze通过要求精确感知、规则解释和受限动作规划，隔离了规则合规的空间规划。为实现可扩展且系统的规则构建，我们提出了语言-逻辑-函数混合方法，该方法自动生成自然语言规则，并将其转换为逻辑表示和可执行验证器，消除了手动规则工程。为了改进规则遵循...
tldr: 本文提出了RuleMaze基准和语言-逻辑-函数混合方法，用于评估和增强多模态大语言模型在遵守自然语言规则下的视觉空间规划能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the RuleMaze benchmark and a Language-Logic-Function Hybridization method to evaluate and enhance multimodal large language models' visual spatial planning under natural-language rule compliance.
